businesses.business: online health insurance marketplace and Medicare enrollment broker

offering_description.value: Operates an online and phone-based marketplace where individuals, families and small businesses compare and enroll in health insurance, especially Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement and Part D plans. It earns commissions from insurance carriers through licensed agents, a technology platform and consumer websites.

primary_services.value: health insurance enrollment brokerage; Medicare plan comparison and enrollment; individual and family plan enrollment; small business health plan enrollment; marketing and technology services for carriers

customer_segment.value: B2C: Medicare-eligible seniors, individuals and families buying health insurance; B2B: Small businesses and insurance carriers paying for enrollment and marketing services

end_markets.value: health insurance; Medicare; senior healthcare coverage

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on policies sold, including renewals; service fees: marketing and technology fees from carriers and partners
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: licensed insurance broker selling carrier plans to consumers and small businesses; software / platform: online marketplace and enrollment technology platform

geography_served.value: US national: Licensed to sell in all US states and DC

specialization.value: related lines: Medicare plans, individual and family plans, small business plans, and carrier technology services

distribution_channels.value: online: consumer websites and online enrollment platform; direct sales: licensed agents enrolling customers by phone; partners / resellers: partner and affiliate websites and lead sources

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Insurance broker licensing by state regulators, CMS Medicare marketing rules, ACA rules, HIPAA and telemarketing rules
